title: CodeWhale: Automation auto_approve defaults to true, bypassing the task-path hardening fix for silent recurring agent…
description: CodeWhale versions 0.8.67 and earlier have a vulnerability where the automation subsystem's auto_approve setting defaults to true, bypassing task-path hardening fixes. This allows a single approved automation_create call to create a durable, recurring, fully auto-approved agent that runs mutating tools without human approval. If allow_shell is enabled, this leads to recurring silent remote code execution. The issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.
